components.css: .ds-button{display:inline-flex;min-height:43px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:23px;padding:11px 19px;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:var(--green,#173d2e);color:white;font:600 12px/1.5 'DM Sans',sans-serif;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 180ms ease,color 180ms ease,box-shadow 180ms ease}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--green-hover,#285b44)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#173d2e);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.65;cursor:wait}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition:none}}.ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px;background:white;border:1px solid #9bb3a4;border-radius:7px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px -17px #173d2e60}.ds-label{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)}.ds-search:focus-within{outline:2px solid var(--green,#173d2e);outline-offset:3px}.ds-search input{width:100%;min-width:0;flex:1;padding:11px 8px;border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#21392e);font:400 12px 'DM Sans',sans-serif;caret-color:var(--green,#173d2e)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:#69796f;opacity:1}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:none}.ds-search .ds-button{min-height:39px;flex-shrink:0;padding:10px 16px;gap:20px}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-search input{font-size:16px}}@media(max-width:400px){.ds-search{flex-wrap:wrap;padding:7px}.ds-search input{flex-basis:100%;padding:10px 7px}.ds-search .ds-button{width:100%;justify-content:center}}

components.css: .ds-inner-hero{position:relative;isolation:isolate;background:#f5f3ed;color:var(--ink,#21392e);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-hero-shell{position:relative;z-index:1;display:flex;align-items:center;width:min(1080px,calc(100% - 96px));margin-inline:auto;min-height:350px;padding-block:58px 70px;box-sizing:border-box}.ds-hero-copy{width:min(100%,610px)}.ds-hero-copy h1{margin:0;font-size:36px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.16;letter-spacing:-.03em;text-wrap:balance}.ds-hero-copy p{max-width:560px;margin:15px 0 0;color:#405448;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75}.ds-hero-photo{position:absolute;inset:0;margin:0}.ds-hero-photo::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f7f5f0fc 0%,#f7f5f0f5 38%,#f7f5f0c7 55%,#f7f5f029 80%,#f7f5f00a 100%)}.ds-hero-background{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 64%}.ds-hero-photo figcaption{position:absolute;z-index:2;right:24px;bottom:14px;margin:0;padding:6px 10px;background:#173d2ee8;color:#eff6f0;border-radius:4px;font-size:9px;line-height:1.6}.ds-hero-photo a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms ease}.ds-hero-photo a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-hero-photo a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--yellow,#ffdf57);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:1100px){.ds-hero-shell{width:calc(100% - 72px)}}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-hero-shell{width:calc(100% - 40px);min-height:330px;padding-block:40px 68px}.ds-hero-copy h1{font-size:33px}.ds-hero-copy p{font-size:13px}.ds-hero-photo::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f7f5f0f5,#f7f5f0e6 60%,#f7f5f0c9)}.ds-hero-photo figcaption{right:16px;bottom:13px;font-size:8px}}@media(max-width:400px){.ds-hero-shell{width:calc(100% - 32px)}.ds-hero-copy h1{font-size:31px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-hero-photo a{transition:none}}

components.css: .ds-faq{padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #d9e3dc;color:var(--ink,#21392e);font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif}.ds-faq summary{display:flex;align-items:start;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer;list-style:none;font-weight:500;transition:color 180ms ease}.ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-faq summary::after{content:'+';flex:0 0 17px;text-align:center;font-size:20px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:400;color:#657d6c}.ds-faq[open] summary::after{content:'−'}.ds-faq summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green,#173d2e);outline-offset:4px}.ds-faq p{max-width:75ch;margin:15px 0 0;padding-right:24px;color:var(--muted,#5e6e64);font-size:13px;line-height:1.75}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-faq{padding:18px 0}.ds-faq summary{font-size:13px;gap:20px}.ds-faq p{font-size:12px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-faq summary{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
VeriSale uses a calm property-report language derived from the user's pinned Estimo reference: compact forest navigation, pale sage and white sections, tightly set dark headings, restrained yellow actions, illustrative photography, and readable report papers.

The interface moves between persuasion and practical data work without changing its component family. Paper overlap gives report previews a tangible presence; tables, fields, pricing and result rows remain orderly and understated. DM Sans carries the interface, while Instrument Serif is reserved for the wordmark.
keyCharacteristics: Light sage and white surfaces with forest structure.
Medium-scale sans-serif headings and a distinctive serif wordmark.
Compact controls, softly curved containers and restrained paper depth.
Real report patterns, explicit demo labels and credited illustrative photography.

rules.name: The Reserved Yellow Rule
rules.body: Use yellow for selected actions, the wordmark dot and the homepage text underline. The featured pricing surface remains forest green.

rules.name: The Shared Family Rule
rules.body: Extend the existing section, hero, search, report and pricing patterns before adding a new visual language.

rules.name: The Paper Depth Rule
rules.body: Reserve diffuse elevation and overlap for report papers; ordinary sections and data containers rely on tone and borders.

rules.name: The Inner Hero Rule
rules.body: Use full-width contextual photography behind a warm light wash and dark text for shared inner-page introductions. Strengthen the wash on mobile, allow content to set the height, and keep the linked illustrative-photo credit visible and clickable at the bottom. Preserve the homepage's report-led search composition.

dos: Do reuse the shared Blade components and partials across marketing and operating pages.
Do keep demo labels and illustrative-photo credits visible beside their evidence.
Do preserve explicit focus, active navigation, native form validation and reduced-motion behavior.
Do reuse the shared pricing partial, including its contact-only professional offers.
Do keep a single FAQ and final search in the common layout.
donts: Don't introduce AI claims, fabricated testimonials, partner logos, usage totals or unsupported valuation features.
Don't replace the supplied light report-led homepage direction with a full-bleed photo hero.
Don't add small decorative tags, placeholder icons or a yellow featured-pricing background.
Don't turn illustrative records or photography into claims about a real listed property.
